falsifiable_hypothesis: The global 24-dimensional James-Stein estimator is stable but shrinks common-mode and target-deviation orientation nuisance identically. A hierarchical decomposition can harvest additional signal but is slightly less fold-stable. A fixed one-eighth innovation hedge should retain the stable estimator as the dominant component.
component_rule: Orientation A is leave-one-whole-patient bagged geometry. Orientation B starts from interpolated-jackknife geometry. No A/B prediction averaging occurs.
global_js_rule: From the three authenticated inner whole-patient bandwidth-0.7 OOF contrast vectors compute cbar, v, sigma2=mean(v), and a_global=max(0,1-22*sigma2/sum(cbar^2)). Define theta_global=(1/8+(7/8)*a_global)*cbar.
hierarchical_js_rule: For each inner-fold contrast vector c[k], let m[k]=mean_t c[k,t], mu=mean_k m[k], and d[k,t]=c[k,t]-m[k]. Estimate a_common=max(0,1-var(m)/3/mu^2), using zero when mu^2 is negligible. Let dbar=mean_k d[k], sigma2_d=mean_t(var_k(d[:,t])/3), and a_dev=max(0,1-21*sigma2_d/sum(dbar^2)), using zero when the norm is negligible. Define theta_hier=(1/8)*cbar+(7/8)*(a_common*mu+a_dev*dbar).
hedge_rule: Use theta=(7/8)*theta_global+(1/8)*theta_hier and q_B=q_B,interpolated_jackknife-0.5*theta. The hedge weight is fixed at one eighth before canonical replay. There is no target/fold outer-outcome routing, scalar grid, or protected data.

task_contract.ab_rule: average separately costed A/B losses; never average predictions
